meaning:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.48
§ Gazzam = "devouring"
the head of a family of temple slaves returning from exile with Zerubbabel

elsewhere.note: the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,
the children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah.
